Der Tatverdächtigte im Fall der tot aufgefundenen 13-jährigen Lisa T. ist an seinen Verletzungen gestorben. Weitere Themen: In Brandenburg gilt ein neuer Wolfsmanagement-Plan. item.title: [DE|Local] BR24 Thema des Tages (Bayern) (Wed 19:00): Untersuchung zu sexualisiertem Fehlverhalten bei der Bundeswehr
item.description:
Originally published Wed 11 Nov 2026 19:00 IST.
Die Bundeswehr hat sexualisiertes Fehlverhalten in ihren Reihen untersucht - und zahlreiche Fälle gefunden. Wir blicken ausführlich auf die Studie, sprechen über Maßnahmen und die Rolle der Frauen beim Bund. Außerdem klären wir, ob sich tatsächlich ausreichend Freiwillige finden und warum die Zahl der Kriegsdienstverweigerer auch ohne Wehrpflicht steigt.Moderation: Claudia Aichberger, Autor: Joachim Dangel

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Wed 18:24): Russia-Ukraine talks: Prisoner release agreed
item.description:
Originally published Wed 11 Nov 2026 18:24 IST.

Russia and Ukraine agree to a large prisoner exchange during trilateral talks mediated by the US, but significant differences remain to achieve a peace deal. Kyiv says a ceasefire must come before any discussions on territory, while Moscow demands Ukrainian forces withdraw from parts of eastern Ukraine. The US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are to travel to Moscow on Thursday to meet Russia's Vladimir Putin, before debriefing Ukraine's President Zelensky during his visit to Dublin.

Also: widespread disruption hits Spain during the country's first general strike in 14 years, prompted by housing shortages and the high cost of living. Will the UN's climate summit make much impact when the world's biggest emitters have declined to join? Deadly floods sweep through Gaza's tent cities, sparking criticism against Israel over an insufficient emergency response. As Manchester United manager Michael Carrick looks set to lose his job, the club begins talks with USA men's coach Mauricio Pochettino. A Sudanese boy who was injured in a drone strike gets prosthetic legs and a greeting from his favourite football player, Real Madrid star Vinícius Jr. And why board games have become so popular again.
